targetText: I'm tired of playing the manager's lady. You can take a wife who is able to appreciate this sort o f life.
explanation: Vassilissa breaks free from her marriage, refusing to accept domestic subjection or tolerate bourgeois double standards.

targetText: I'm not going to the new place with you. I've been called back to work. And I'm going to stay there.
explanation: Vassilissa asserts her independence, prioritizing socialized work and political commitment over marriage to an unfaithful manager.
